# EquipChain Contracts — 100-Item Hardening Backlog

Derived from a full audit of `contracts/utility_contracts/src` (lib.rs + modules).
One improvement per commit. Status: `[ ]` todo, `[x]` done.

- [x] **#2 sweep_dust admin path never calls require_auth — auth bypass** (HIGH)
- [ ] **#3 create_continuous_stream/withdraw_continuous never move tokens — unbacked paper balances** (HIGH)
- [ ] **#4 add_continuous_balance mints bookkeeping without collecting tokens** (HIGH)
- [ ] **#5 refund_buffer marks buffer refunded without token transfer** (HIGH)
- [ ] **#6 velocity-limit family lets caller pass their own address as `admin`** (HIGH)
- [ ] **#7 collect_streaming_fees resets accrued counter, never transfers tokens** (HIGH)
- [ ] **#8 fee accrual never happens: StreamingFeeAccrued is never incremented** (HIGH)
- [ ] **#9 GasBountyPool debit unconditionally underflows to negative** (MED)
- [ ] **#10 sweep_dust credits dust accounting while transferring nothing** (HIGH)
- [ ] **#11 sweep_dust ignores `token_address`; sweeps every token to a single wallet** (MED)
- [ ] **#12 sweep_dust processes only first N stream ids** (MED)
- [ ] **#13 lock_guarantor_deposit accepts wrong collateral token for existing deposit** (HIGH)
- [ ] **#14 lock_guarantor_deposit/settle_postpaid_debt missing reentrancy locks** (MED)
- [ ] **#15 deduct_units missing pause guard, offline-recon double-pay, reentrancy lock** (HIGH)
- [ ] **#16 sync_actual_balance zeroes users' full balances for partial clawbacks** (HIGH)
- [ ] **#17 route_to_yield is placeholder simulation; replace with honest no-op + views** (MED)
- [ ] **#18 collect_streaming_fees callable by anyone, no auth** (MED)
- [ ] **#19 route_to_yield missing admin auth** (MED)
- [ ] **#20 stream_device_heartbeat lacks stream/meter binding validation** (MED)
- [ ] **#21 pause_stream/resume_stream don't settle accrual on pause** (MED)

## Methodology

- Every fix ships with a regression test proving the bug and the fix.
- One commit per item, detailed message with what/why.
- Batches pushed to main after all items in the batch pass `cargo test`, `clippy`, and wasm build.
